sn56.43:1.2: tattha yaṃ kiñci cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, aniṭṭharūpaṃyeva passati, no iṭṭharūpaṃ. akantarūpayeva passati, no kantarūpaṃ. amanāparūpaṃyeva passati, no manāparūpaṃ.
sn56.43:1.4: ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati …pe… jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusati …pe…
sn56.43:1.5: yaṃ kiñci manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti, aniṭṭharūpaṃyeva vijānāti. no iṭṭharūpaṃ. akantarūpaṃyeva vijānāti. no kantarūpaṃ. amanāparūpaṃyeva vijānāti. no manāparūpanti.
sn56.43:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn56.43:2.2: “mahā vata so bhante, pariḷāho sumahā vata so bhante, pariḷāho.
sn56.43:2.3: atthi nu kho bhante, etamhā pariḷāhā añño pariḷāho mahantataro ca bhayānakatarocā”ti?
sn56.43:2.4: atthi kho bhikkhu, etamhā pariḷāhā añño pariḷāho mahantataro ca bhayānakatarocāti.
sn56.43:3.1: katamo pana bhante, etamhā pariḷāhā añño pariḷāho mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti?
sn56.43:3.2: ye hi keci, bhikkhu, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe…
sn56.43:3.3: “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti, te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti …pe… te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu
sn56.43:3.4: abhiratā …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsasaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiratā jātisaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharonti …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsasaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharonti. te jātisaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsasaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre
sn56.43:3.5: abhisaṅkharitvā jātipariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti. jarāpariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti. maraṇapariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti. sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsapariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti.
sn56.43:3.6: te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi.
sn56.43:4.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhu, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti,
sn56.43:4.4: anabhisaṅkharitvā jātipariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti, jarāpariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti, maraṇapariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsapariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti.
sn56.43:4.5: te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn56.43:5.1: tasmātiha bhikkhu, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe…“ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
